notes.title: Patch Note 1.3
notes.content:
Patch Notes for KOLOSS – Version [1.3]

New Feature: The Army


 A new army mechanic has been introduced! The army consists of small groups of soldiers that march down three paths between the two castles.
 These groups will engage in combat with each other along the way, and if they manage to reach the enemy castle, they will deal damage!
 Strategize your army movements to either clash with opposing forces or focus on damaging the enemy’s stronghold!


Bug Fixes


 Fixed several minor bugs to improve the multiplayer experience.
 Addressed issues with the gameplay to ensure smoother gameplay.


Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for playing KOLOSS!
